name: SM_Sign_Healer_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset (not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2): the task for the unclaimed families asks for a baked set per asset, and the surface detail here (see dresses) does not exist in the shared library
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: healer's hanging sign: timber post and bracket with a brace, a 72 x 48 cm board on two iron straps, painted with a worn red cross
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: The bracket stands on its own post so the sign can be placed free or against a wall; the original hangs from a wall bracket only. Straps are flat bars, not chain. The cross is one painted shape with procedural flaking; the back of the board carries the same cross. Boards are bevelled blocks butted together: no joints, pegs, nails or tool marks are modelled, and the grain is procedural streaking, not a scan. Every board is 12 triangles in the game mesh, so edge rounding is in the normal map only.
